user.title: Set up Solar Forecast AI
user.description: Configure your solar panels. Location is automatically detected from Home Assistant ({latitude}°N, {longitude}°E). No API key required!

data_description.peak_power: Total installed power of all panels at Standard Test Conditions (STC). Found on your inverter's nameplate.
data_description.performance_ratio: System efficiency including inverter, cable losses, soiling. Typically 0.75-0.85. Leave default if unsure.
data_description.production_sensor: Select a sensor tracking daily energy production (kWh). The AI model learns from this to become more accurate over time.
data_description.consumption_sensor: Select a sensor tracking current power consumption (W or kW). Used for self-consumption prediction.

error.no_location: Please set your Home Assistant location first via Settings → System → General.
error.invalid_peak_power: Peak power must be greater than 0 kWp.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Open-Meteo. Check your internet connection.

abort.already_configured: Solar Forecast AI is already configured.

init.title: Solar Forecast AI options
init.description: Update settings. The AI model retains its learned corrections.
